m: परि-√ 3. हा P. -जहाति, (ind.p. -हाय; inf. -हातुम्), to leave, abandon, quit, R.; BhP.; to omit, neglect, disregard, Mn.; MBh.; Hariv. : Pass. -हीयते (with fut. -हास्यति, MBh.), to be avoided or omitted, be destitute or deprived of, desist or be excluded from (abl.), be wanting or deficient, be inferior to (abl. or instr.), wane, fail, decrease, pass away, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -हापयति, to cause to relinquish or abandon, Naiṣ.; to interrupt, leave unfinished, Mn. viii, 206.
a: परिहा — {c3c} P. 1 To leave, abandon, quit --2 To omit, neglect; यथोक्तान्यपि कर्माणि परिहाय Ms. 12. 92. --Pass. 1 To be wanting or deficient in; आर्यस्य सुविहितप्रयोगतया न किमपि परिहास्यते Ś. 1. --2 To be inferior to; ओजस्वितयान परिहीयते शच्याः V. 3; न प्रतिच्छंदात्परिहीयते मधुरता M. 2. --3 To wane, fail, waste away; अनुदिवसं परिहीयसे अंगैः Ś. 3; Pt. 1. 78. --4 To pass away; परिहीयते गमनवेला Ś. 4. --5 To be deprived of or excluded from.

m: परि-हाण n. being deprived of anything, suffering a loss (only अ-परिह्˚), ŚāṅkhBr.
a: परिहाणं — Ved. 1 Losing, suffering loss. --2 Decrease.

m: परि-हाणि or परि-हानि, f. decrease, loss, deficiency, Ragh.; Var.; Suśr. (cf. Uṇ. iv, 51, Sch.)
a: परिहाणिः(निः) — f. 1 Decrease, deficiency, loss. --2 Decay, decline; R. 19. 50. --3 Neglect, omission.

m: परि-हापणीय mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be omitted, Kād.
परि-हापित mfn. robbed or deprived of (instr.), BhP.
परि-हाप्य ind. excluding, excepting (acc.), except, ĀpŚr.

s: puM, (parihriyate'neneti । pari + hf + GaY .) avajYA । anAdaraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (“parihAro nAma tasyEva dozavacanasya pariharaRaM yaTA nityamAtmani SarIrasTe jIvaliNgAnyapalaByante tasya cApagamAnnopalaByante tasmAdatyaH SarIrAdAmA nityaH SarIrAcceti .” iti carake vimAnasTAne'zwame'DyAye ॥ tyAgaH । parivarjjanam । yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 4 । 676 । “durvvfttasya praBoranyat parihArAt na Bezajam ॥” gopanam । yaTA, SakuntalAyAM 1 ma aNke । “kaTamidAnImAtmAnaM nivedayAmi kaTaM vA AtmanaH parihAraM karomi ॥” vijitadravyAdikam । yaTA, manuH । 7 । 201 । “jitvA sampUjayet devAn brAhmaRAMScEvaDArmmikAn । pradadyAta parihArAMSca KyApayedaBayAni ca ॥” sTAnaviSezaH । yaTA, manuH । 8 । 237 । “DanuH SataM parIhAro grAmasya syAt samantataH ॥” atra kullUkaBawwaH । “caturhasto DanuH SamyA yazwistasyAH pAtaH prakzepo grAmasamIpe sarvvAsu dikzu catvAri hastaSatAni trIn vA yazwiprakzepAn yAvat paSupracArArTaM SasyavapanAdisaMroDaparihAraH kAryyaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ pari + hf॰ GaY vA dIrGaH । 1avajYAyAM anAdare SabdaratnA॰ । 2 dozAdyudDAraRe
m: परि-हार &c. See परि-√ हृ.
परि-हार (परि-), m. leading round, KātyŚr.
delivering or handing over, Nyāyam., Sch.
shunning, avoiding, excluding, abandoning, giving up, resigning, ŚBr. &c. &c.
seizing, surrounding, W.
concealment, reserve, MBh.; Śak.
leaving out, omission, Sāh.
taking away, removing, (esp.) removing by arguments, confutation, Śaṃk.
caution, Car.
contempt disrespect, L.
objection, L.
any objectionable thing or person, W.
(in gram.) the repetition of a word (before and after इति cf. परि-ग्रह), APrāt.
(in dram.) remedying or atoning for any improper action, Sāh.
an extraordinary grant, exemption from taxes, immunity, Mn.; R.; MārkP.; Rājat.
= -स्थान (below), Mn. viii, 237
bounty, largess, W. (cf. परी-ह्˚)
a ring, Inscr.
a: परि(री)हारः — 1 Leaving, quitting, giving up, abandoning. --2 Removing, taking away; as in विरोधपरिहार. --3 Shunning, avoiding. --4 Refuting, repelling. --5 Omitting to mention, omission, leaving out. --6 Reserve, concealment. --7 A tract of common land round a village or town; धनुःशतं परीहारो ग्रामस्य स्यात्समंततः Ms. 8. 237. --8 A special grant, immunity, privilege, exemption from taxes; Ms. 7. 201. --9 Contempt, disrespect. --10 An objection. --11 Seizing, keeping back. --12 Bounty. --13 (In gram.) The repetition of a word before and after इति; cf. परिग्रह. --14 Atoning for any improper action.

m: परि-हारक mf(इका)n. repelling, refuting, MW.
परि-हारक m. or n. an armlet, L. (cf. ˚हरक and परिहाटक).
परि-हार—स्थान n. a space of common land extending round a village or town, Kull. on Mn. viii, 238.
परि-हार—सू f. (a cow) bearing a calf only after a long time (of barrenness), TS., Sch.
1. परि-हार—वत् mfn. avoidable, MBh. (अ-परिह्˚)
2. परि-हार—वत् ind. (ifc.) like the omission of Sāh.
परि-हार—विशुद्धि f. (with Jainas) purification by such mortification and penance as are enjoined by the example of ancient saints or sages, W.
परि-हारिका f. a kind of riddle, Kāvyād.
परि-हारिन् mfn. (ifc.) avoiding, shunning, Daś.; Bālar.
परि-हार्य mfn. to be shunned or avoided or omitted or escaped from, MBh.; R. &c.
to be severed or separated, Kathās.
to be taken off or away, W.
to be endowed with a privilege, Yājñ., Sch.
to be repeated (cf. ˚हर्तव्य), APrāt.
परि-हार्य m. a bracelet, L. (cf. पारिहार्य).
a: परिहार्य — a. To be shunned or avoided, to be escaped from, to be taken off or away. --र्यः A bracelet.

s: puM, (pari + hf + Ryat .) pArihAryyaH । valayaH । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥ pariharaRIye tri ॥ (yaTA, SakuntalAyAm 1 me aNke । “na parihAryye vastuni pOravARAM manaH pravarttate ॥”)
v: tri pari + ha--karmaRi Ryat । 1 pariharttavye 2 tyaktavye dvirUpakozaH । 2 udgAvye ca

v: pu pari + hasa--GaY vA dIrGaH । narmaRi likA॰
m: परि-हास m. jesting, joking, laughing at, ridiculing, deriding
a jest, joke, mirth, merriment, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. परी-ह्˚)
a: परि(री)हासः — 1 Joking, jesting, jest, mirth: merriment; त्वराप्रस्तावोयं न खलु परिहासस्य विषयः Māl. 9. 44; परिहासपूर्वं ‘jokingly or in jest’ R. 6. 82; परिहासविजल्पितं Ś. 2. 18 ‘uttered in jest’; परीहासाश्चित्राः सततमभवन् येन भवतः Ve. 3. 14; Ku. 7. 19; R. 9. 8; Śi. 10. 12. --2 Ridiculing, deriding. --Comp. --वेदिन् m. a buffoon, jester, a witty person.

m: परि-हास—शील mfn. of a gay or joyous disposition, fond of jesting, Var.; Kāv.
परि-हास—शी˚ल-ता f., Ratnāv.
परि-हास—हरि m. N. of a temple of Viṣṇu, Rājat.
परि-हास—कथा f. an amusing story, Ragh.
परि-हास—पूर्वम् ind. jokingly, in jest, Ragh.
परि-हास—पुर n. N. of a town, Rājat.
परि-हास—वस्तु n. an object of jest (˚स्तु-ता f.), Pañc.
परि-हास—वस्तु-ता f.
परि-हास—वेदिन् m. a jester, a witty person, W.
परि-हास—विजल्पित mfn. uttered in jest, Śak.
परि-हास्य mfn. laughable, ridiculous, MW.
परि-हाटक mfn. consisting or made of pure gold, MBh.
a ring worn round the arm or leg, an armlet, anklet, L.
परि-हीण mfn. (also written हीन) omitted, lost, disappeared, wanting, MBh.; Kāv.; BhP.
abstaining from, deficient in, deprived or destitute of (abl. or -तस् instr., or comp.), ib.
a: परिहीण — p. p. 1 Waned, wasted. --2 Deprived or destitute of. --3 Wanting or deficient in.

m: परि-ह्णुत mfn. (√ ह्नु) denied, refused, AV.
परि-हूत mfn. called together, BhP.
called all round (?), Hir.
परि-हणन n., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 22, Sch.
परि-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to wind round, Kāṭh.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; to extinguish (fire), ŚBr.; Pass. -हन्यते, to be changed or altered, MBh. (v.l. प्रति-ह्˚) ; to cease, perish, Pañc. (v.l. -हीयते).

v: avya॰ hanDorupari SravyayI॰ । hagnorupari tataH parimuKA॰ BavArTe Rya । pArihanavya tatra Bave tri॰

m: परि-हर ˚रण &c. See परि-हृ.
परि-हर m. v.l. for ˚हार, reserve, concealment, Śak. (Pi.) i, 24/25.
परि-हरणीय mfn. to be shunned or avoided, Śak.; Prab.
to be taken away, W.
to be confuted, ib.
परि-हरणीय—ता f. disdain, rejection, Śiś.
disappearance, unattainableness, ib.
refutation, ib.
परि-हरण n. moving or taking round, ŚrS.
avoiding, shunning, VP.
leaving, W.
seizing, ib.
refuting, ib.
a: परिहरणं — 1 Leaving, quitting, abandoning. --2 Avoiding, shunning. --3 Refuting. --4 Seizing, taking away. --5 Ved. Carrying or placing round.

m: परि-हरक m. v.l. for ˚हारक, L.
परि-हर्तव्य mfn. to be handed over or forwarded, Nyāyam., Sch.
to be shunned or avoided or abstained from, Nir.; Kāv.; Pañc.
to be kept secret or concealed, Mṛcch.
to be confuted, Śaṃk.
to be repeated (before and after इति cf. next), APrāt.
परि-हर्षण ˚षिन्. See परिहृष्, p. 605.
परि-हर्षण mf(ई)n. greatly delighting, MBh.
परि-हर्षिन् mfn. delightful, MBh.
परि-हर्षित mfn. greatly delighted, ib.
परि-√ हस् P. -हसति (Pass. aor. पर्य्-अहासि), to laugh, jest or joke with (acc.), laugh at, ridicule, deride, MBh.; Kathās.; Rājat.
a: परिहस् — {c1c} P. 1 To jest, joke. --2 To laugh at, ridicule: (hence) to surpass, excel; जनानामानंदः परिहसति निर्वाणपदवीं G. L. 5.

m: परि-हसित mfn. laughed at, ridiculed, MW.

v: avya॰ parirvarjane avyayI॰ । hastasya varjane tasya nirudakAditvAt antodAttatA ।
m: परि-हस्त m. (g. निर्-उदकादि) an amulet put round the hand to secure the birth of a child, AV.
a: परिहस्तः — A ring for the hand.

m: परि-हत mfn. (Śak. v, 22/23 & Gīt. v, 13) w.r. for परि-हृत.
परि-हव m. (√ ह्वे) crying or calling upon, invoking (?), AV.

परि-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते (fut. -हरिष्यति, MBh.; aor. 3. pl. -अहृषत, RV.; ind.p. -हृत्य, R.; Var.; -हारम्, Br.), to move or carry or take round, TS.; Br.; GṛŚrS.; to put or wrap round (Ā. round one's self), AV. &c. &c.; to put aside, save for (dat.), ŚBr.; to leave, quit, desert, Śiś.; to defend or preserve from (abl.), ChUp.; to spare, VP.; to shun, avoid, leave out, omit, ŚBr.; Gobh.; to save or spare anything (as trouble, care &c.) to (gen.), Ratnāv.; to take away, remove, beware of or abstain from (acc.), MBh.; VP.; (Ā.) to keep away from i.e. neglect, not heed, Āpast.; to answer, refute, Pat.; Śaṃk.; to put twice, repeat (in the Krama-pāṭha), APrāt.; to nourish, foster, cherish, Lalit. : Desid. -जिहीर्षति, to wish to keep away or avoid or shun, remove or conceal, Gobh.; R. (cf. -जिहीर्षा, p. 594).
a: परिहृ — {c1c} P. 1 To avoid, shun: स्त्रीसंनिकर्षं परिहर्तुमिच्छन्नंतर्दधे भूतपतिः सभूतः Ku. 3. 74; Ms. 8. 400; Ku. 3. 43. --2 To forsake, abandon, leave, desert; कति न कथितमिदमनुपदमचिरं मा परिहर हरिमतिशयरुचिरं Gīt. 9. --3 To remove, destroy; answer, refute (as objections, charges &c.); ब्रह्मास्य जगतो निमित्तं कारणं प्रकृतिश्चेत्यस्य पक्षस्याक्षेपः स्मृतिनिमित्तः परिहृतः . तर्कनिमित्त इदानीमाक्षेपः परिह्रियते S. B; Me. 14. --4 To conceal. --5 To embrace.

v: tri॰ pari + hf--kvip । parihftya gantari f 6 । 45

m: परि-हृत mfn. shunned, avoided, Kāv.
abandoned, quitted, W.
taken, seized, ib.
परि-हृत n. what has been wrapped round or put on BhP.
a: परिहृत — p. p. 1 Shunned, avoided. --2 Left, abandoned. --3 Refuted, repelled (as a charge, objection &c.). --4 Taken, seized.

m: परि-हृति f. shunning, avoiding, AitBr.
1. परि-हृत्य ind. keeping away, excluding, with the exception of (acc.), R.
at a distance of (acc.), Var.
2. परि-हृत्य mfn. to be delivered or handed over, AitBr.
परि-√ हृष् Caus. -हर्षयति, to delight greatly, cause to rejoice, MBh.; Hariv.
परि-हृषित mfn. delighted, very glad, ib.
परि-हृष्ट mfn. id. (-मानस mfn., R.)
blunt, obtuse (teeth), Bhpr.
परि-हृष्ट—मानस mfn., R.
परि-√ हि P. -हिनोति, to send or forward to (dat.), RV. vii, 104, 6.
परि-हिंसा f. (√ हिंस्) = परि-बर्हणा, Nir., Sch.
परि-√ हिण्ड् Ā. -हिण्डते, to fly about, Daś.
परि-हित mfn. put round or on, covered, invested, clothed, RV.; &c.
परि-हित See परि-धा, p. 596.
परि-ह्रुत् mfn. (√ ह्वृ) causing to fall, RV.
परि-ह्वालम् ind. (√ ह्वल्) stammering, faltering, ŚBr.
परि-ह्वृत See अ-परि-ह्वृत.
परि-ह्वृति (परि-), f. deceiving, injuring, harming, RV. viii, 47, 6 (loc. हृता!); ix, 79, 2.
